The Bright Side:
Encourages substantive debate on foreign policy and economic conservatism rather than silent coronation.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Focusing on WHO (personality clashes) rather than WHAT (the underlying ideological direction of the conservative movement).

Social Physics Analysis:
Instead of suppressing internal dissent, open competition invites coalition members to articulate their distinct visions for the party's future.

The Unavoidable Truth: Political parties thrive on open ideological contestation rather than predetermined succession.

The Unavoidable Lie: Ambition is entirely divorced from policy conviction.
